No text file of the clone states a travel range, a minimum step delay or a ramp time, so move_relative.displacement, move_absolute.target_position and focus_relative.z are Limit.operator_required; site-limits.example.json supplies example-only bounds and the operator must supply the real envelope. The firmware has no separate stop command; the @estop and the safe_state action both call release_motors() (release), which de-energises the coils. No independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone, so estop_physical_ref is not set; risk stays R1 per the card floor and the low-energy microscope-stage class. NOT COVERED: the optional LightSensor module (light_sensor_intensity, integration time, gain; arbitrary units, compile-time optional) is not exposed; the endstop reads return null when the module is absent. BasicSerialInstrument is the serial transport base of the native class, Endstops is used through native.endstops, and OpenFlexureStage is the native class.
